    order_amount,
    SUM(order_amount) OVER (
        PARTITION BY customer_id
        ORDER BY order_id
    ) AS running_total,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY customer_id
        ORDER BY order_amount DESC
    ) AS order_rank
FROM orders;

prose/philosophy-memory.content:
— Elizabeth Gilbert

The human brain is a remarkable and complex organ. It is the seat of our consciousness, our emotions, and our memories. But it is also a fallible and malleable organ, one that is constantly changing and adapting to our experiences.

One of the most fascinating aspects of the brain is its ability to form memories. Memories are not simply stored in the brain like files in a computer. Instead, they are reconstructed each time we recall them. This means that every time we remember something, we are not just retrieving a static record of the past, but we are actively reconstructing it.
